description: Elixir's defoverridable: after defoverridable f: n, a later def f/n replaces the earlier clauses instead of adding to them (today a duplicate def gives a redundant-clause warning and the first clause wins). Needed by defexception's default exception/1 and message/1. Own proposal page before building.
title: defoverridable: a later def of the same name and arity replaces an overridable one
